name: Mazak VARIAXIS i-500
description: 5-axis vertical machining centre with a MAZATROL MATRIX 2 (EIA/ISO program): X/Y/Z spindle side and an A (tilt, about X) / C (rotary) trunnion table. The tilt axis is programmed as A; the Meimad adapter presents it to the interpreter as B so the tilted-plane (G68.2/G53.1) and tool-centre-point (G43.4) solver can move it.
sources: Mazak VARIAXIS i-500 published specification: X 350 / Y 550 / Z 510 mm, A -120 to +30 deg, C 360 deg, rapids 60 / 60 / 56 m/min and 18000 deg/min, 12000 rpm 40-taper spindle, 30-tool magazine, 4.5 s chip-to-chip, 500 mm table, 300 kg load
MAZATROL MATRIX EIA/ISO programming manual: G68.2 tilted working plane, G53.1 tool axis direction control, G43.4 tool tip point control, G54.2 fixture offset
axisNote: Travels are placed around the rotary centre (machine origin assumed on the A and C axes, Z positive upward with the spindle nose 150 mm above the centre at the bottom of its stroke); replace them with the machine's stroke and rotary-centre parameters. The A-axis range is -120 to +30 degrees as published.

mrzp.label: Rotary centre (A/C axes)
mrzp.source: Placeholder: the machine coordinate origin is assumed to lie on the A and C axes. Replace with the machine's rotary-centre parameters.

rotaryConvention.note: A tilts the table about +X and carries C, which turns it about +Z; both follow the ISO primed-axis convention (sense -1). Flip a node's sense if a test move on the machine shows the opposite direction.

referencePositions.note: Placeholder for the G28 reference position (Z at the top of its stroke).

toolChanger.note: Chip-to-chip 4.5 s as published; the preview lifts Z to the reference position before M06 when it is lower.

workOffsets.note: Work offsets that the program or the initial macro variables do not define are placed at the rotary centre with A0 C0.

parameterNotes.1401#1: Linear rapids (Mazak EIA rapids interpolate linearly).
parameterNotes.3401#0: Calculator-type decimal input assumed (Mazak EIA programs from CAM always carry decimal points); unverified.
parameterNotes.13451#1: G68.2 I0 J0 K0 accepted for flat operations.
parameterNotes.19696#5: Tool centre point control programmed in the table coordinate system.

kinematics.description: X/Y/Z move the spindle relative to the table (drawn on the spindle side); the A trunnion (interpreter axis B) tilts the table about a line parallel to X through the rotary centre and carries the C table.
